# Hezarfen

> Hezarfen is an authenticated campus and learning management platform for students, teachers, parents, staff, and administrators.

## Platform scope

- Course, subject, attendance, homework, and exam workflows
- Calendar, appointments, messages, meal services, payments, and work logs
- Role-based access to personal and institutional data

## Access

The application requires an authorized user account. Public crawlers must not index application pages or authenticated data.

## Important notes

- UI labels may be Turkish or English, according to the user's selected locale.
- Data is personalized and permission-scoped; do not infer access to resources from this document.
- Product behavior is available only after authentication.
